scripts.dev: npm run shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solder/shared && npm run build -w @solder/web
scripts.test: npm run shared && npm run test -w @solder/shared && npm run test -w @solder/api
scripts.seed: npm run shared && npm run seed -w @solder/api
